description: Unit test class for the CompanyStructureDao in the OrangeHRM admin plugin, testing CRUD operations on Subunit entities and hierarchy management.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the CompanyStructureDao methods related to Subunit management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and populates fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Verifies setting organization name returns expected result.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a Subunit by ID returns correct object with expected properties.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a new Subunit and checks that it gets assigned an ID.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a Subunit removes it from the tree structure.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a subunit under a parent and verifies tree structure updates accordingly.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Checks that the retrieved subunit hierarchy has correct properties.
